Definition
[inner product on the tensor algebra]

Source: petersen:page-0082

If $V$ has an inner product with orthonormal basis $e_1,\dots ,e_n$ and dual basis $e^1,\dots ,e^n$, the inner product on $T(V)$ declares $e_{i_1}\otimes \cdots \otimes e_{i_p}\otimes e^{j_1}\otimes \cdots \otimes e^{j_q}$ an orthonormal basis of the $(p,q)$-tensors.
